description: This file defines a set of functions in CMake scripting language for handling JSON data, including callbacks for building result structures like objects and arrays, and functions for parsing JSON literals and building JSON strings. It appears to be part of a CMake-based build process, likely used to generate or process JSON data within CMake projects.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function to parse JSON data, initialize context, and invoke callbacks for JSON components.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to mark the beginning of a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to mark the end of a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to mark the beginning of a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to mark the end of a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to process the start of a key-value pair in a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to process the end of a key-value pair in a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to process the end of an array element.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Processes a JSON literal value such as null, boolean, number, or string.
